nodes.label: Driver Adapter Requirement for SQL in v7
nodes.rationale: v7 requires driver adapters for SQL: no native engine binary in the Prisma Client SQL path, smaller bundles, better serverless/edge compatibility, native Node.js drivers, and explicit pool control.

nodes.label: Driver Adapter Package Matrix
nodes.rationale: Maps each database to its adapter package and underlying driver (e.g., PostgreSQL → @prisma/adapter-pg over pg; Prisma Postgres serverless → @prisma/adapter-ppg over @prisma/ppg).
